prompt: Add a global error boundary that catches server errors and displays a user-friendly message with a retry button.
criterion: Error boundary catches server errors and displays retry button that reloads the page correctly.

prompt: Create a reusable button component that accepts variant props and applies Tailwind CSS classes conditionally.
criterion: Button renders correctly with all specified variants and no hardcoded styles or missing classes.

prompt: Add a loading skeleton UI for a server component that fetches data, ensuring it appears before content renders.
criterion: Skeleton appears immediately on load and disappears when data is rendered, no flash of empty content.

prompt: Use next/font to load a custom font and apply it globally via CSS variables in the root layout.
criterion: Custom font loads correctly and applies to all text without FOIT or layout shift.

prompt: Implement a server action that updates user preferences and redirects upon success using redirect from next/navigation.
criterion: Server action executes, updates data, and redirects without client-side form submission.

prompt: Implement a server component that conditionally renders different content based on user role from cookies.
criterion: Content renders correctly based on cookie value and no client-side role detection occurs.

prompt: Create a client component that uses useState to toggle a theme and persists the preference in localStorage.
criterion: Theme toggle works client-side and retains state across page refreshes via localStorage.

prompt: Create a Next.js App Router page that fetches data from an API using server components and displays it in a card layout without client-side hydration.
criterion: Page renders server-side content correctly with no client-side JavaScript used for data fetching or rendering.

prompt: Implement a dynamic route in App Router that accepts a slug parameter and displays corresponding content from a static data file.
criterion: Route correctly resolves slug parameter and displays matching content without 404 or incorrect data.

prompt: Implement a server component that fetches data from two parallel API calls using Promise.all and renders results.
criterion: Both API calls resolve successfully and data renders together without sequential delays or errors.
